name: heart_rate_zones
description: Heart-rate training zones: maximum heart rate estimated by Tanaka (208 - 0.7 x age), Fox (220 - age) or Gellish (207 - 0.7 x age), or measured, and zones by heart-rate reserve (Karvonen, with resting heart rate) and by percentage of maximum, on default five-zone or custom boundaries. Exact arithmetic; every output carries a disclaimer: not medical advice, verify with a clinician.

age.description: Years; needed unless max_hr is given

method.description: Default both with resting_hr, else percent_max

catalog.source: Karvonen, Kentala & Mustala, Ann Med Exp Biol Fenn 1957;35:307 (heart-rate reserve); Tanaka, Monahan & Seals, J Am Coll Cardiol 2001;37:153; Fox, Naughton & Haskell 1971; Gellish et al., Med Sci Sports Exerc 2007;39:822
